_comment: DEFAULT Signal group invite links shipped with the public template (operational links, not secrets). Replace the placeholder links with your own groups — or DELETE this file if you do not use Signal, which hides the step. The Broadcast group is shared by everyone in scope; the Chat link differs per role. A role key being present puts that role in scope for the Get-Started 'Join Signal groups' step (it always gets Broadcast); a chatUrl additionally renders a Chat button. Omit the file to hide the step entirely.
